_comment: pflow_artifact engine "wasm" loads this script from jsDelivr before the page script: @pflow-xyz/engine (pflow-rs crates/pflow-artifact-engine, commit 44643a4), one UMD file that embeds the same reachability engine as artifact/engine.wasm and defines the global PflowEngine. Pinned to an exact version, never a range or latest; integrity is the SRI hash of that file as built and published, so a changed file refuses to run. TestArtifactEngineCDNPinned holds this. To move it: publish a new version, check `npm view`, then update version, integrity and sha256 together.
